title: Describing Motion
summary: Grade 9: distance and displacement, speed and velocity, acceleration, motion graphs, the equations of motion, and uniform circular motion.

ib.statementOfInquiry: Mathematical models of motion let us describe, predict and design the movement of everything from metro trains to satellites.

factual: What is the difference between distance and displacement?
What do the slope and area of a velocity–time graph tell us?
conceptual: Why can an object moving at constant speed still be accelerating?
How do graphs and equations describe the same motion?
debatable: Should speed limits near schools be lower than they are?
Is it more useful to know your speed or your velocity?

cbseChapters: Class 9 (Exploration, 2026) Ch 4: Describing Motion Around Us
